impact: Signals HOOD wants a seat in regulated tokenized equities alongside NYSE and ICE efforts, a long-term positive for its crypto and 24/7 trading push but no near-term revenue.
summary: Robinhood told CoinDesk it did not object to its shares trading as tokens on the planned OKX-ICE venue, joining only Securitize and BitGo; 56 of 62 companies proposed have opposed it. The venue relies on the SEC's innovation exemption and has no launch date.
title: Robinhood backs tokenized trading of its stock on OKX-ICE venue
